court: High Court of Judicature at Bombay
case_name: Neha Nakul Toshniwal vs Nakul Vinay Toshniwal
facts_of_case: Parties in a marriage dispute, seeking to resolve outstanding issues and convert petition into one by mutual consent under Section 13-B of the Hindu Marriage Act.

legal_principles.principle: Parties can amicably resolve disputes through mediation.
legal_principles.held: The mediation proceedings were conducted successfully and the report of the mediation dated 04/06/2022 is received by this court.

legal_principles.principle: Consent terms can be executed to resolve disputes and form part of the decree.
legal_principles.held: The necessary consent terms shall be executed between the parties before the Family Court within one week and the marriage between them shall be resolved in terms of the consent terms to be filed before the Family Court, which shall also form part of the decree of divorce.

outcome.final_order: The parties have agreed to mutually and amicably resolve all existing disputes, claims, and/or counter-claims between them. The marriage petition shall be converted into a petition by mutual consent under Section 13-B of the Hindu Marriage Act.
